summary: Iter15 verifies (1) 8 kHz mono review audio, (2) auto-fill Disc title from MIDI first-track name or prettified file stem, (3) melody_fill accompaniment-borrow option. Backend: 108/108 pytest green (101 prior + 7 new iter15). test_iter13_render_pins asserts updated from 6000 Hz to 8000 Hz per request. New iter15 asserts: POST /api/render baby1 tracks=5 returns audio/wav with X-Sample-Rate=8000, wave framerate=8000, nchannels=1, sampwidth=2; POST /api/scan whoscheating.mid title=="Who's Cheatin Who", baby1.mid title=='', sample_twinkle.mid title is string; POST /api/analyze baby1 start=18.7 duration=25 tracks='5' melody_fill=false -> 32 notes, melody_fill=true -> 60 notes (dropped=0); tracks='' (all) -> melody_fill no-op; POST /api/render whoscheating tracks='3' melody_fill=true X-Notes (352) > melody_fill=false X-Notes (272). FRONTEND (public URL): title-input auto-fills — whoscheating.mid -> "Who's Cheatin Who", baby1.mid -> 'baby1', sample_twinkle.mid -> 'sample twinkle'; melody-fill-check default ON after upload; LOAD NOTES stat-notes=32 with fill, uncheck -> stale-badge appears -> LOAD NOTES stat-notes=6; render-song-button -> render-meta '9 side(s) · 352 toy notes · 25.5 s · from 12.2 s · transposed +12 st · 86% match · 8 kHz mono'; toggling melody-fill-check clears render-result. Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: fisher_price.py is now 1304 lines — still past the 700-line split threshold. The three melody helpers (_skyline, _melody_fill, scan_tracks melody scoring) are good candidates for a melody.py module.

_melody_fill thinning uses t - last >= 0.25 s but doesn't dedupe against notes already in `sel` at the same time bucket; borrowed notes that collide with a melody onset still get appended before the sort. parse_midi_events relies on downstream snapping/merge to clean this up — explicit dedupe would be safer.

parse_midi_events computes `others` as tracks with mean >= 55 to skip bass; the same 55-cutoff appears in scan_tracks is_bass. Extract as a module-level BASS_MEAN_THRESHOLD constant to keep them in sync.

stem() in Creator.js caps to 40 chars but the backend title is also sliced to 40 — if a MIDI track_name is exactly 40 chars it may be mid-word; acceptable for a titlebar but worth a UI tooltip showing the full value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter15: review audio is now 8 kHz mono (RENDER_RATE=8000). /api/scan returns `title` (MIDI first-track name, 40-char slice). Frontend scanFile prefers MIDI title, falls back to stem(filename) via dropAnalysis->onFileA on every upload. melody_fill (form bool) in /api/analyze,/autofit,/render,/album borrows skyline from non-bass OTHER tracks across rests > 1.5 s in the chosen melody track, thinned to >=0.25 s and dedup bucket 0.1 s. UI: TrackPicker exposes melody-fill-check, default true; toggling it in Creator sets stale and clears render result. Render meta string now ends with '8 kHz mono'.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification pass (no bug reported). All three asked-for enhancements landed cleanly; only pre-existing code-quality smell is file length.
